injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain.

injuries.name: Keegan Murray
injuries.note: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.note: Ingram (Achilles) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.note: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.note: Knueppel (hamstring) will practice with the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Thursday, the Hornets announced.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL.

injuries.name: Cameron Johnson
injuries.note: Johnson (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against Phoenix.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.note: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks.

injuries.name: Ivica Zubac
injuries.note: Zubac (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months.

injuries.name: Marcus Smart
injuries.note: Smart (forearm) is questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.note: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.note: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Santi Aldama
injuries.note: Aldama (knee) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against Houston.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.note: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.note: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Utah, Paul Garcia of ProjectSpurs.com reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Suggs
injuries.note: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.note: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.note: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.note: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: Reed Sheppard
injuries.note: Sheppard (back) is out for Friday's game against the Mavericks.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.note: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March.

injuries.name: Egor Demin
injuries.note: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

injuries.name: Coby White
injuries.note: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.note: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns.

injuries.name: Max Strus
injuries.note: Strus (foot) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.note: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.note: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Spencer Jones
injuries.note: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.note: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: Dylan Cardwell
injuries.note: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Patrick Williams
injuries.note: Williams (adductor) is questionable for Friday's game in Boston.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.note: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Jose Alvarado
injuries.note: Alvarado (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.note: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.note: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Devin Carter
injuries.note: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.note: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Alex Caruso
injuries.note: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.note: Pacers head coach Rick Carlisle stated McConnell (hamstring) is "doing better" and "getting closer" to a return, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.note: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.note: Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.note: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.note: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.note: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.note: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Jabari Walker

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.note: Niederhauser (foot) had his third-year team option picked up Thursday by the Clippers.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti

injuries.name: Adou Thiero
